notes: LIVENESS: westelm.in is LIVE and actively trading (unlike sibling S.N. 198 West Elm UAE, which is permanently closed per c198.json's Alshaya maintenance-notice precedent). Homepage returns HTTP 200 direct-fetch, rendered og:image/logo/font assets are served from cdn.fynd.com, and the storefront runs on the same Reliance/Fynd commerce platform (application_id 5e9e465a7398c2abde186051, company_id 46) as sibling S.N. 283 Pottery Barn India (c283.json) -- confirming this is India's Reliance-operated West Elm franchise, a genuinely independent platform/catalogue from westelm.com (US) and westelm.co.uk (UK), consistent with the brand's established GCC/India franchise pattern. Full checkout/cart flow, INR pricing, and store-locator pages are present; no maintenance/closure notice found. DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK: not a duplicate of S.N. 2 West Elm US or S.N. 60 West Elm UK (different platform, different catalogue, independently operated India storefront) -- same determination pattern as Pottery Barn India vs Pottery Barn US/UK. ACCESS ROUTE: direct HTTP GET throughout (no WAF encountered, no robots.txt Claude-specific disallow); mega-menu (nav) scraped for category structure, then each /collection/<slug> leaf page fetched directly for its qty. COUNT METHOD: qty taken from the site's own rendered 'N items' listing-header text (same method validated exact in the Pottery Barn India precedent, where Chandeliers(9)+Pendants(6)=15 matched the parent's own displayed total). For two categories with visible contamination, further verification was done: (1) 'Outdoor Planters' was fully enumerated across 5 sort-order permutations (default/price-asc/price-dsc/latest/discount), converging on exactly the 16 unique SKUs the header claims, of which 2 are faux plants (excluded per scope) -- yielding a verified exact qty of 14; (2) 'Decorative Objects & Sculptures' could only be sampled to 33 of its stated 42 SKUs (site ignores page/pagination/price-filter query params server-side, capping enumeration), and 9 of those 33 are Christmas/Holiday ornaments cross-tagged from a separate Christmas Decor collection -- qty set to null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag since the exact in-scope count could not be verified. EXCLUSIONS (not emitted as rows): all Furniture, Rugs, Pillows & Throws/Cushions/Pouffs, Bedding, Bath Linens/Towels/Mats/Curtain poles, Table Linen (Napkins, Placemats + Runners -- textile), Flatware (cutlery), Bar Accessories + Decanters (bar tools, matching West Elm US/UK precedent of excluding this category entirely), Candles + Diffusers (page title itself reads 'Scented Candles & Home Diffusers' -- Home Fragrance, not the in-scope unscented-candle carve-out), Jewellery + Display Boxes (storage/organizational, matching Pottery Barn India's 'Baskets & Storage' exclusion precedent), Baskets & Hampers (title 'Stylish Storage Baskets & Laundry Hampers' -- storage), Faux Plants + Flowers (dedicated collection, explicitly excluded), Outdoor Accessories & Decor parent page (verified to contain ONLY Outdoor Pillows content -- both pages return the identical 16-item header/title pattern, entirely textile), Outdoor Pillows (textile), Christmas/Holiday Decor and Holidays Dinnerware collections (Holiday & Gift), all Gifts-by-category/price/occasion/recipient pages and Sale pages (filter/collection roll-ups, never-extract rule), Collections/Curated Collections/New Arrivals/Best Sellers (never-extract rule). No Clocks category exists anywhere on the site -- confirmed via full 509-URL collections-sitemap enumeration (probe.py sitemap + collections.sitemap.xml), zero 'clock' matches. An orphaned, empty 'outdoor-lanterns-and-candleholders' sitemap URL (0 products, nav-icon images only, not linked from the mega-menu) was found and skipped as it has no content to extract. RULE 0: Lighting/Mirrors/Vases/Planters etc. all in scope regardless of the room word used in their site labels (e.g. 'Bathroom Accessories', 'Outdoor Planters') -- judged strictly by product type.
